name: FLOOWBOX - AI Agent with Long-Term Memory (Mem0 Pattern)

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Agent with Long-Term Memory
Day 30 — implements the Mem0 memory pattern.

Flow:
1. Retrieve memories for this user from Qdrant
2. Inject memories into agent system prompt
3. Agent responds naturally using context
4. Extract new facts from conversation
5. Embed new facts → store back to Qdrant

Memory persists across sessions via vector DB.
Directly implements research on: persistent agent memory,
personalization, memory management in LLM systems.
